dog.description_text:
Meet Scottie - a floppy, goofy, ridiculously lovable boy who has been busy winning over his foster humans with his good looks AND good manners. Scottie is Lab/Weimaraner - 29lbs - 6 Months Old - the perfect combination of a fun, playful puppy and professional couch potato. He loves exploring outside, making new friends, playing fetch, and taking his very important daily naps. Did we mention how smart he is? He loves his crate and spending time in there. He learned fetch AND “drop it” in about 20 minutes, is already letting his foster know when he needs to go potty as he works on potty training, and is he is an excellent listener! His foster describes him as gentle and eager to please. He’s got a medium energy level, the sweetest personality, and a tail that apparently never stops wagging… even when he’s asleep. Scottie is ready to bring his big puppy paws, floppy cuddles, and tail wags to a forever home. Could it be yours?

Apply to adopt Scottie at rescuecity.nyc/adopt
